analysis.bootstrap_unit: environment; paired clean/stress and all methods share draws
analysis.intervals: pointwise95percent percentile; conditional on fixed policies and residual bank
analysis.planned_contrasts: stress-minus-clean for each of five method groups

draw_rule: For each environment seed/finger use independent random.Random seed from first8 SHA256 bytes, big-endian, of sensor-stress-20402020/{environment_seed}/{finger}; choose eligible trajectory uniformly then valid block start uniformly. All realized finger pairs are distinct; no rejection/resampling was needed.
limitations: Source normal labels approximately0.073–1.888N; simulator budget8N is outside observed load range.
Single-sensor trajectory errors mapped to separately drawn finger blocks; cross-finger error correlation is not measured.
One source index per20Hz simulator observation is imposed; no real acquisition frequency/latency is assumed.
Regression residual includes estimator, target measurement, preprocessing and alignment error, not identified electronics noise.
Only normal observations are perturbed; shear, images, proprioception and ground-truth outcomes remain unchanged.
Reuses existing held-out public predictions as perturbation library; not a new public-dataset model evaluation.
Long-trajectory-conditioned subset and fixed additive error transport; not physical sensor validation or sim-to-real.

observation_rule.no_contact_caveat: Contact-derived errors are also added to zero-contact observations; false positives there are synthetic, not an empirically identified no-contact sensor distribution.

scope: Appendix diagnostic: index-aligned synthetic application of empirical held-out normal-force regression residuals; no validated sensor or sim-to-real claim

source.seed_choice: First prespecified existing model seed, not chosen by control-test or residual performance
